dataset_id: gov.kz krem documents + news; adilet Minenergo price-cap orders
indicator_name: Utility tariff decisions (КРЕМ and its regional departments) and Ministry of Energy electricity and gas price caps: events by month of entry into force
description: Решения о тарифах на коммунальные услуги (КРЕМ, ДКРЕМ) и предельные цены Минэнерго на электроэнергию и газ: события по месяцу вступления в силу
unit: percent change of the tariff (NaN when the source does not state it)
methodology: EVENT dataset, one record per decision and service, dated by the first day of the month the decision takes effect. item_code = REGION.SERVICE.KIND.SOURCE_ID (REGION KZ = national; SERVICE HEAT, HOT_WATER, WATER, WATER_BULK, SEWER, ELEC_TRANS, ELEC_SUPPLY, GAS_DISTR, GAS_TRANS, GAS_STORAGE, GAS_RETAIL, ELEC_GEN_CAP, GAS_WHOLESALE_CAP; KIND APPROVE, AMEND, TEMP_COMP (temporary compensating tariff: a cut), EMERGENCY, CAP_CUT, PRICE_CAP, NEWS, ORDER, PERIOD; SOURCE_ID D<gov.kz document>, N<gov.kz news>_<n>, V…/G… adilet act). item_name: service | decision | company | order | effective date and its basis | change | source URL. (1) КРЕМ/ДКРЕМ orders from the gov.kz «krem» documents listing, read from the TITLE (the order files are scans): 3 413 records 2011-2026, value NaN; effective date stated in 178, estimated as the month after the order date in 2 689 and as the month after publication in 546 (only Карагандинская and Шымкент, which publish within days). (2) КРЕМ press releases: 90 records, 53 with the stated % change (2019-2026). (3) Minenergo electricity generation caps (orders 514 and 508-н/қ and their amendments, old.adilet.zan.kz): 20 acts 2019-2026, value = mean % change of the caps across producer groups for the effective year (16 with a value). (4) Minenergo wholesale gas caps by region (yearly orders 2014-2022, order 210 of 2023 with periods to 2027/28): 202 region-period events, value = % change against the previous period; the 2027-07 period is transformation «forecast». Coverage is uneven across regions: departments that put order dates in titles dominate (Карагандинская 1 116, Костанайская 753, Алматы 428 records; Мангистауская 15, Северо-Казахстанская 10). Sources overlap (a release may report an order that is also listed): aggregate by (date, region, service). See TARIFF_CHANGE_MONTHS for the months the CPI registered the changes.
